primary_endpoint: Time to first usable inference within the 6 GiB cgroup against the physical payload_bytes/measured_bandwidth bound, and zero post-enforcement executions across concurrent queued and in-flight EK5 revocation races with an exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound

design.separation_rule: materialized_payload_count (real .cspg files) is never conflated with catalog_entry_count (manifest slots); catalog lookup is timed separately from payload swap

revocation.enforcement: EK5 SUPERSEDE attestation checked and committed atomically under one lock
revocation.bound: exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound (0 events in n -> 1 - 0.05^(1/n))

design.comparator: physical bandwidth bound and queued/in-flight revocation fence

tiers.local-drycheck: floor: synthetic .cspg payloads, page-cache-warm bandwidth tier on Windows, no cgroup enforcement

evidence_disclosure.scope: Live cartridge-array run on a Linux cgroup host (6 GiB memory cage, swap 0); 57_verifier recomputes manifest/deterministic hashes, gate set and the zero-event Clopper-Pearson bound from the committed receipt.
evidence_disclosure.tier_note: Physical cold-read tier as disclosed in the manifest (tier_disclosure); catalog of 1000 entries with 250 materialised payloads.
evidence_disclosure.synthetic: Cartridge payloads and the revocation race workload are synthetic.
evidence_disclosure.tuning: Race trial count (300) and the cage size are preregistered; the unguarded control shows the race is real.
evidence_disclosure.sla: Swap/first-inference times and cgroup facts are recorded measurements range-checked only; not reproducible off the Spark host.
